    ONNX 与 TensorRT 加速

    先跑通 PyTorch RGB 示例。HccePose 可用 ONNX Runtime 执行网络前向计算，TensorRT 则通过 ONNX Runtime 的执行提供程序运行。检测、坐标解码、PnP 和结果整理仍在原流程中。

    后端与缓存选择

    PYTHON
    from HccePose.tester import Tester

tester = Tester(
    dataset,
    CUDA_DEVICE='0',
    hccepose_vis=False,
    hccepose_acceleration='onnx',
    hccepose_acceleration_cache_dir=None,
)
results = tester.predict(cam_K, image_bgr, [1])

    将 'onnx' 改为 'tensorrt' 选择 TensorRT，'pytorch' 为默认路径。acceleration 与 acceleration_cache_dir 是兼容别名。上述参数不切换 YOLO 或 MegaPose 的执行后端。

    默认每个物体使用 <dataset>/HccePose/obj_XX/onnx_cache/，其中包含导出模型及 TensorRT engine 缓存。文件名记录 checkpoint、输入尺寸等信息，不要把不同网络或设备的缓存混用。首次导出与 engine 构建可能显著增加启动时间。

    初始化与环境变化

    选择 ONNX/TensorRT 时，ensure_acceleration_backend_environment 会检查工具包、PyTorch 和常用依赖，并可能通过当前解释器安装缺失包。使用独立环境；主环境中的 CUDA PyTorch 需先安装好。

    • 环境准备可能调整 NumPy 到 1.26.4，安装指定 OpenCV 包。
    • ONNX Runtime 已能导入时，不保证它就是 GPU 版本；检查实际 provider。
    • TensorRT 需要兼容的 ONNX Runtime、CUDA、驱动与 libnvinfer。仅安装 tensorrt Python 包不代表当前 ONNX Runtime 支持 TensorRT。
    • TMPDIR 与 PIP_CACHE_DIR 可用于选择临时目录及 pip 缓存；不要把模型资源目录与临时目录混淆。

    源码与上游接口见 HccePose runner。当前项目保留 HccePose 网络加速入口。

    检查 provider 与输出

    PYTHON
    runner = tester.HccePose_Runtime_Item[1]
print(runner.session.get_providers())

    ONNX 路径优先 CUDA，再到 CPU；TensorRT 路径优先 TensorRT，再到 CUDA、CPU，实际可用性取决于安装。注册 provider 与每个算子的实际执行并非完全等价，需要结合 ONNX Runtime 日志。完整 HccePose 流程仍需要 CUDA。

    对比后端时，固定图像、权重、PnP 设置及可视化开关，并分别保存结果。掩码和坐标差异反映数值一致性，最终精度需按 BOP 对照真值评估。多实例场景不能仅按列表位置匹配两个独立检测结果。

    对比示例与计时

    公开上游包含 ONNX 对比脚本 与 TensorRT 对比脚本。它们位于上游根目录，需按实际资源调整输入路径。

    首次运行可能包含下载、依赖安装、导出或构建，不应计入稳定重复推理的速度。time 和 time_dict 为墙钟计时，定义见结果字段。主机与 GPU 间的数据搬运、检测和 PnP 仍可能成为瓶颈，因此网络前向加速不等于整条流程同比加速。

    ONNX and TensorRT acceleration

    First run the PyTorch RGB example. HccePose can execute its network forward pass with ONNX Runtime; TensorRT uses ONNX Runtime’s execution provider. Detection, coordinate decoding, PnP and result assembly remain in the existing pipeline.

    Select a backend and cache

    PYTHON
    from HccePose.tester import Tester

tester = Tester(
    dataset,
    CUDA_DEVICE='0',
    hccepose_vis=False,
    hccepose_acceleration='onnx',
    hccepose_acceleration_cache_dir=None,
)
results = tester.predict(cam_K, image_bgr, [1])

    Change 'onnx' to 'tensorrt' for TensorRT; 'pytorch' is the default. acceleration and acceleration_cache_dir are compatibility aliases. These arguments do not select YOLO or MegaPose backends.

    Each object defaults to <dataset>/HccePose/obj_XX/onnx_cache/, including exports and TensorRT engine caches. Filenames identify the checkpoint, input size and related details. Do not mix caches from incompatible networks or devices. Initial export and engine building can substantially increase startup time.

    Initialization and environment changes

    Selecting ONNX/TensorRT invokes ensure_acceleration_backend_environment, which checks the toolkit, PyTorch and common dependencies and may install missing packages using the current interpreter. Use a dedicated environment and install CUDA-enabled PyTorch beforehand.

    • Preparation may change NumPy to 1.26.4 and install pinned OpenCV packages.
    • An importable ONNX Runtime is not necessarily GPU-enabled; inspect its actual providers.
    • TensorRT requires compatible ONNX Runtime, CUDA, drivers and libnvinfer. Installing the tensorrt Python package alone does not ensure this ONNX Runtime supports TensorRT.
    • TMPDIR and PIP_CACHE_DIR can select temporary storage and pip caches; distinguish these from model resources.

    See the public HccePose runner. The current project retains the HccePose network acceleration entry point.

    Inspect providers and outputs

    PYTHON
    runner = tester.HccePose_Runtime_Item[1]
print(runner.session.get_providers())

    The ONNX path prefers CUDA, then CPU; TensorRT prefers TensorRT, CUDA, then CPU, subject to availability. Registered providers do not fully describe actual operator placement; consult ONNX Runtime logs. The complete HccePose pipeline still requires CUDA.

    For comparisons, fix images, weights, PnP options and visualization settings, and preserve separate results. Mask and coordinate differences measure numerical agreement. Accuracy needs ground-truth BOP evaluation. Do not match independent multi-instance detections merely by list position.

    Comparison recipes and timing

    Public upstream includes ONNX and TensorRT comparison scripts. They live in the upstream root; adjust input paths for your assets.

    First use may include downloads, installation, export or engine building. Separate those from repeated inference. time and time_dict are wall-clock measurements defined in results. Host/GPU transfers, detection and PnP can remain bottlenecks; faster network execution does not imply proportional end-to-end acceleration.
